variants.name: 小文字で書く・id で選ぶ・BEGIN TRANSACTION

begin: update accounts set balance = balance + 9000 where id = 2;
undo: update accounts set balance = balance - 9000 where id = 1;
move: update accounts set balance = balance - 1000 where id = 1;
update accounts set balance = balance + 1000 where id = 2;

variants.name: 1 行にまとめて確定する・途中で確かめる

begin: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 9000 WHERE name = '石田'
undo: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 9000 WHERE name = '青木'
same: SELECT SUM(balance) AS total FROM accounts
move: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 1000 WHERE name = '青木'; UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 1000 WHERE name = '石田'; COMMIT

wrong.why: COMMIT を打たずに、BEGIN から打ち直す
retry: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 1000 WHERE name = '青木'
UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 1000 WHERE name = '石田'
